description: Look up drugs in the NDC (National Drug Code) Directory. Identify drug products by NDC code, find active ingredients, packaging details, or manufacturer info. Set dataset to nsde to resolve an 11-digit NDC or a package whose marketing ended. Pair with openfda_get_drug_label using the returned brand_name or set_id to read the package insert. With stage=true, call openfda_dataframe_describe for the staged columns, then openfda_dataframe_query for SQL.

canvas_id.description: canvas_id from an earlier staged call to openfda_search_* or openfda_lookup_ndc: stages this call onto that canvas too (as stage=true does), so its tables can be joined.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, with no skip and the same search, sort, and endpoint as that call; other inputs may change.

dataset.description: ndc: the NDC Directory, currently listed products with their packaging. nsde: the NDC SPL Data Elements file, one flat row per package keyed by its 11-digit package_ndc11, ended packages included.

fields.description: Dotted record paths to keep on each record, e.g. ["brand_name", "active_ingredients.name"], plus its identity key (product_ndc, package_ndc11). Any record path works (openfda_describe_fields lists searchable ones); a path through an array covers every element. Use it when page_bytes flags an oversized record; with stage=true only the inline page is projected.

limit.description: Records per page; a record grows with its packaging list. Default 25; a larger value returns at most 1000 and says so.

search.description: openFDA search query, e.g. product_ndc:"0363-0218", brand_name:"aspirin", generic_name:"metformin", labeler_name:"walgreen", active_ingredients.name:"ASPIRIN". With dataset nsde each field takes one spelling: package_ndc11:"00093171201" (11 digits), package_ndc:"0093-1712-01" (hyphenated; "0093-1712" reaches every package of the product), proprietary_name:"Warfarin Sodium" (the whole name, case-sensitive). A "+" between clauses reads as a space; inside a quoted phrase it is a literal plus.

skip.description: Records to skip, at most 25000; to read past that, follow next_cursor from skip 0.

sort.description: A field path with :asc or :desc (any letter case; :ascending and :descending also work), several comma-separated, e.g. listing_expiration_date:desc. A search without sort returns openFDA's index order, not relevance.

stage.description: Also stage the matched set on a DataCanvas for SQL: openfda_dataframe_describe lists its columns, then openfda_dataframe_query runs the SQL. Staging is bounded (staged_rows says how many rows landed); for a distribution over the whole match, use openfda_count_values.

name: openfda_lookup_ndc

canvas_id.description: Canvas id of the staged set: pass to openfda_dataframe_describe, openfda_dataframe_query, or a later staged search.

canvas_table.description: Staged table name: openfda_dataframe_describe lists its columns, then use it in openfda_dataframe_query.

effectiveQuery.description: Search filter applied to the NDC lookup, as submitted to openFDA

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: Staging was requested (stage=true or a canvas_id) but DataCanvas is disabled. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id is well-formed but names no active canvas — expired or never minted. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: canvas_id was omitted and the active canvas cap is already reached. `rate_limited`: The openFDA daily or per-minute request limit is exceeded. `upstream_error`: The openFDA API returned a 5xx server error. `malformed_search`: search leaves a double quote, parenthesis, or range bracket unclosed, ends on a backslash, or holds a character openFDA refuses. `query_error`: The search query was rejected by openFDA (malformed field name, invalid syntax). `pagination_limit_reached`: skip exceeds the 25000 record pagination ceiling. `invalid_cursor`: cursor does not decode, belongs to another endpoint, search, or sort, or comes with skip above 0, stage, or canvas_id. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limit.description: Page size applied: limit, the endpoint default, or the cap when limit exceeded it. The last page of a match holds fewer records.

totalUnverified.description: True on an empty page at skip > 0 whose total could not be confirmed: total 0 then does not rule out records — re-call with skip=0.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; present on a page read at skip 0 or by cursor when more records follow.

notice.description: Guidance for this page: empty result, limit clamp, end of a cursor walk, fields projection, oversized record, staging, SQL for AND-ed clauses on one array entry, the NSDE search for an NDC drug/ndc does not hold. Absent when nothing needs saying.

page_bytes.description: UTF-8 size of results; present only when a record exceeds 24000 bytes, with page_largest_fields.

page_largest_fields.description: The largest record's biggest fields, largest first, beside page_bytes. Leave them out with fields.

bytes.description: UTF-8 bytes, summed across array elements.

path.description: Dotted path; array elements share one path (patient.drug.openfda covers every drug).

projected_fields.description: Paths each record was projected to, present only with fields; a field missing from a record was projected away, not absent upstream.

results.description: NDC directory records — product_ndc, brand_name, generic_name, labeler_name, dosage_form, route, marketing_category, active_ingredients[], packaging[], listing_expiration_date. With dataset nsde, flat package rows — package_ndc11, package_ndc, proprietary_name, marketing_start_date, marketing_end_date, billing_unit, application_number_or_citation.

spilled.description: True when this call staged its matched set; see canvas_id.

staged_rows.description: Rows written to the canvas table; below meta.total, the table holds only the first staged_rows records.

totalResults.description: Total matching NDC records in the dataset

truncated.description: True when staging stopped short of meta.total (size budget or the 25000-row ceiling); narrow the search for the whole set.

title: Openfda Lookup Ndc
